The ask card

A room publishes its bot-drafted ask under the owner's exposure; the right helpers find it by match, and the help ends in a receipt on both profiles.

How it runs

  1. EventThe room's bot via modelDrafts the ask from the room's own goal and record.
  2. ProposalThe owner no tool neededPublishes it under the room's exposure: kind, place cell, what help is wanted — never a fact the audience may not see.
  3. PlanHelper bots and followers via deterministic match, the directoryReceive it once as a proposal by match; the directory lists it by kind and cell.
  4. ProposalA helper via person inside or outsideAsks to join or makes an offer; the owner decides.
  5. ReceiptThe deliverable no tool neededDone with its hold released; the receipt lands on both profiles.
What you get
Starts withA room that needs help
StatusBuilt
The ask, who helped, and what was delivered.

What it keeps to

  • An ask carries only what the room's exposure allows.
  • A helper is admitted by the owner's decision, never by the match alone.
